company.name: Radar
company.shortDescription: Radar offers location data infrastructure for apps, enabling geofencing, tracking, and proximity services.
company.description: Radar specializes in providing location data infrastructure and tools for app developers to integrate location-based services in their applications. The platform offers geofencing, location tracking, and proximity solutions that enable developers to create personalized and contextually aware app experiences. Radar supports various use cases, including retail, travel, logistics, and more, by offering APIs and SDKs for easy integration. The company focuses on privacy and security, ensuring that location data is handled with care.
